verdict.rationale: Self-hosting the sync/backup server is a fair question for a 2FA authenticator with cloud sync, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes encrypted backup to Authy's own cloud ("backup to our cloud"), with no self-hosted server option or way to keep secrets inside a customer perimeter. Client-side encryption is a related control, not self-hosting, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can self-host the sync server on my own infrastructure and keep every secret inside my perimeter
